slides.title: The honest fox
slides.text: Once upon a time there was a small fox. She was hungry, so she looked for food in the forest. Suddenly she found a basket of berries, but a note said: 'For Anna.' The fox was hungry, but she did not eat them. When Anna arrived, she gave the fox some berries as a thank you. The fox was happy, and Anna was too.
slides.pt: Uma raposa esfomeada não come as frutas de uma menina e é recompensada.
